Base panels and filling clearance A flat-bottom construction requires its own panel layout and base dimensions. Confirm the side-panel folds, opening width and the way the bag will be supported during filling. Do not transfer a conventional doypack dieline to this reference without redrawing the panel and seal geometry. Carry opening and filled weight The reference image includes a handle-related feature. Review lifting, edge clearance and the actual weight rather than approving from an empty-bag photograph. Nylon candidate and product edges PA, BOPA or nylon is listed as a candidate component.
